comment: Explicit deferrals for docs/research/2026-10-29-universal-modpack-install.md §2 formats that have no registered adapter. Read by scripts/conformance-spec.mjs, which fails if a format here also has an adapter (stale waiver) or if a format has neither. Rule (docs/audit/24-deviations-register.md): a recorded deviation is data, an unrecorded one is a QA failure — so every deferral must carry a reason.
schema: priority = the §2 table priority; format = the §2 table name; reason = one line, why it is not implemented yet
